verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that ScrapingBee blocks all images and CSS by default to speed up requests, with `block_resources=false` to opt out. A related `block_ads` parameter allows further trimming of page load. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that default blocking reduces bandwidth or latency, and in-depth documentation of what blocking covers (e.g. fonts, media) and its interaction with credit cost.
